crossRefs.note: “Sanctify to me all the firstborn, whatever opens the womb among the children of Israel, both of man and of animal. It…
that you shall set apart to Yahweh all that opens the womb, and every firstborn that comes from an animal which you…
“You shall not delay to offer from your harvest and from the outflow of your presses. “You shall give the firstborn of…
Everything that opens the womb, of all flesh which they offer to Yahweh, both of man and animal, shall be yours.…
The first of all the first fruits of every thing, and every offering of everything, of all your offerings, shall be for…
(as it is written in the law of the Lord, “Every male who opens the womb shall be called holy to the Lord”),

translations.web: “All that opens the womb is mine; and all your livestock that is male, the firstborn of cow and sheep.
translations.bsb: The first offspring of every womb belongs to Me, including all the firstborn males among your livestock, whether cattle or sheep.
translations.kjv: All that openeth the matrix is mine; and every firstling among thy cattle, whether ox or sheep, that is male
translations.asv: All that openeth the womb is mine; and all thy cattle that is male, the firstlings of cow and sheep.
